The '''Miss Coruscant talent and beauty pageant''' was a competition held at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] focused on judging and ranking the talents and the physical attributes of the contestants, who were all [[Gender/Legends|female]]. The competition's winner was rewarded with a bouquet of [[Flower/Legends|flowers]] and a crown that said [[Miss Coruscant]], hence the title of the event.<ref name="HoloNet Life">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|52|life/13418_1.html|Chatrunis Crowned Miss Coruscant}}</ref>

Shortly before the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Pa'lowick/Legends|Pa'lowick]] [[Larisselle Chatrunis]] won the Miss Coruscant talent and beauty pageant by beating out the 35 other contestants.<ref name="HoloNet Life" />
